name: Corca
text: Corca, also written Corco, is a variant spelling of Corcu. The word is an Old Irish term for population groups, and by extension for the lands they held. A close English rendering is clan. Irish tribal and place names keep the form, as in the later peoples Corcu Baiscinn and Corcu Duibne.

attributes.attribute: Old Irish word for population groups, by extension their lands

okr.objective: Record the Corca spelling and the sense of Corcu.
key_results: Identify Corca and Corco as variants of Corcu.
Render Corcu as an Old Irish word for peoples and their territories.
Name Corcu Baiscinn and Corcu Duibne among the peoples formed with it.
